nodes.text: [i]The ribbon on the Margin Gate stays tied. A small tag hangs from it: 'Not enough people know your name yet.'[/i]
[i]Renown {renown} / 220. Beat Errors, open chests, solve riddles, light posts, explore: any of it counts. The page remembers what you do.[/i]
[i]The Margin Gate is shut, a wall of pages bound with ribbon. Its lock is shaped like a full stop.[/i]
[i]Whatever lies beyond cannot be opened until the Prologue is finished: Thistledown still has an Editor.[/i]
